about:
I am a Full Stack Developer at CARE Health Insurance with 1.5+ years of professional experience building scalable web applications, backend systems, and cloud-integrated solutions. Alongside my professional work, I am a final-year Computer Science student at IIIT Kota with strong interests in full stack engineering, scalable system design, AI-driven applications, and modern software architectures.

My experience includes working with technologies such as React.js, Node.js, Angular, TypeScript, Go, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Docker, Redis, and AWS. At CARE Health Insurance, I contribute to enterprise-grade platforms by developing secure APIs, optimizing backend performance, improving database efficiency, integrating AWS S3-based systems, and enhancing frontend applications for better scalability and reliability.

Beyond professional work, I have built multiple full stack and backend-focused projects involving authentication systems, community platforms, REST APIs, cloud deployments, caching systems, and performance optimization. I have also explored AI/ML concepts including LLM-based applications, sentiment analysis, CNNs, RNNs, and LSTMs through personal projects and experimentation.

I possess strong problem-solving and coding skills in C and C++, with hands-on experience solving 350+ DSA problems across platforms such as LeetCode, GeeksforGeeks, and Codeforces. My technical foundation includes Data Structures & Algorithms, DBMS, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, and System Design.

Apart from engineering, I have actively contributed to college technical and creative communities through Codebase (open-source and hackathon club) and Artive (creative society), where I collaborated on technical events, development activities, and team-based initiatives. I was also the captain/core member of the volleyball team and participated in multiple tournaments, which strengthened my leadership, teamwork, consistency, and communication skills.

I enjoy solving real-world engineering problems, learning emerging technologies, and building impactful digital products that combine scalability, performance, and user-centric design.
